title: LILA SWIPE card
description: Frozen contract between the deck presser and the app. Source keys from the store are preserved under raw_inputs, never renamed. Derivations are tested against lila_fixtures/varonis_candidate_row.json. our_score and our_components ride in the data and are NEVER rendered.

id.description: notice_id or award/forecast record id; doubles as receipt record_id

kind.description: derived from notice_type and status; near_miss only for salt

seal_key.description: agency seal asset key, preloaded in the app bundle

basis.description: one line in the CO's words: the sentence containing the top matched term, extracted from notice text in notices.db

days_remaining.description: recomputed at press from pool build date, never trusted from the store

contact_present.description: POC exists on record; no PII on the card, ever

source_url.description: sam_url or equivalent public receipt URL

our_components.description: HIDDEN. Six terms derived from raw ingredients, each normalized to [0,1]. Keys are placeholders pending FSOS docs reconciliation.

raw_inputs.description: source values used in derivation, preserved under their ORIGINAL key names (status, tier, leverage_rank, dates, set_aside, vehicle, dollar fields). Do not rename.

salt.description: true only for near_miss; authentic store rejects, never synthetic

rejection_reason.description: from the filter rerun; near-misses carry one

overlap.description: in the cross-persona overlap set; one budget with retest

retest.description: returned on model-crowd disagreement; rides inside the overlap budget

sentence_vec.description: full matched-sentence embedding, computed once at pool build, stored always, consumed as scalar reductions until EMBEDDING_VECTOR_GATE

fixture.description: development fixture row; a deck containing any fixture row must never be minted into a real executive link
